SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch S.2.
REPORT
Date March 25, 1935
Subject (in full) A.V. Marzikoff - character of.
Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by
With reference to the communication dated March 18, 1935
from the Netherlands Consulate-General regarding one Alexei
Vasilivitch Marzikoff, I have to state that there is nothing
in Police records against this individual from either a
political or moral point of view.
He is known to Russian members of the Special Branch, to
whom he has been of assistance on divers occasions.
Facts do not support the belief that Marzikoff is trying
out every Consulate here, for enquiries show that he has not
made application for visa to either the British or American
consular authorities..
We do not know of any particular reason, apart from the
one given, why he should wish to go to Europe.
Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch/
D.S.
（手写签名：D.S. Jones）
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别处 S.2.
报告
日期：1935年3月25日
事由（全称）：A.V. Marzikoff - 品行鉴定。
制作人：D.S. Jones 转呈人

关于荷兰总领事馆1935年3月18日来函，提及一名名为 Alexei Vasilivitch Marzikoff 之人，本人谨此声明，从政治或道德角度来看，警方档案中并无对此人的不利记录。
特别处的俄籍成员对其有所了解，他曾在多个场合向他们提供协助。
事实并不支持“Marzikoff 正在向此处各领事馆逐一试探”的看法，因为调查显示，他并未向英国或美国领事当局申请签证。
除其所陈述的理由外，我们不知其为何希望前往欧洲的任何其他特定原因。
副总监，
特别处/
D.S.
（手写签名：D.S. Jones）

S. B. P. GI T
No. D 6521
Date

March 25 35.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. 998 of March 18, 1935, and to state
that nothing is known to the Municipal Police from a
political or moral point of view against Alexei
Vasilivitch Markizoff. Enquiries made by a member of
the Special Branch failed to confirm a report that
Markizoff is trying to obtain visas from other local
Consulates in order to enable him to proceed to Europe.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 998.

SHANGHAI, 18th March 1935.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Alexei Vasilivitch
MARKIZOFF, a barber, born at Narwa, 14 October 1895, residing at
Route des Soeurs 142, a naturalised Chinese citizen (naturalisation
cert. d.d. 14-1.35, character □ ,No.40), holder of a passport
issued by the local Bureau of Public Safety (No.250457, character 公 ,
No.2227), has applied to this Consulate General for a visé for
admission into The Netherlands, where he intends to take up re-
sidence in the interest of his health and for the purpose of edu-
cation of his son, born at Harbin on 7 April 1924.

He states to have arrived in Harbin in 1919, which city he
left in 1924 for Dairen, Tientsin and Shanghai, leaving the latter
place in the course of 1927 for Singapore, where he stayed from 31
August 1927 till 11 January 1928, then returning to Shanghai, where
he established his own barbershop at the above address about 6
years ago.

He seems to have been married in 1920. His wife according to
his statement died in 1928. They had no other children than the
son above mentioned, who at present attends the Municipal school
at Rue Remi.

I have tried to explain to the applicant that it would be very
difficult for him to make a living in Europe on account of the vast
unemployment prevailing in almost every European country, his
ignorance of any other language but Russian and his lack of money.

He states to have saved about $ 3000.-- which is a comparitively
small sum. If he found no work, it would be spent very quickly,
after which he would be left destitute.

I think Mr.Markizoff is trying out every Consulate here
and

T.P.Givens,Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch),
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

编号 998.

上海，1935年3月18日。

先生：

兹荣幸通知阁下，Alexei Vasilivitch MARKIZOFF，理发师，1895年10月14日生于纳尔瓦（Narwa），现居姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）142号，系已归化之中国公民（归化证书日期为1935年1月14日，品行 □ ，编号40），持有本地公安局签发的护照（编号250457，品行 公 ，编号2227），已向本总领事馆申请进入荷兰的签证，他打算为了健康原因以及为其子（1924年4月7日生于哈尔滨）受教育之目的，在荷兰定居。

他声称于1919年抵达哈尔滨，并于1924年离开该市前往大连、天津和上海，后于1927年间离开上海前往新加坡，在那里从1927年8月31日停留至1928年1月11日，随后返回上海，约6年前在上述地址开设了自己的理发店。

他似乎于1920年结婚。据他陈述，其妻于1928年去世。除上述儿子外，他们无其他子女，该子目前就读于雷米路（Rue Remi）的工部局学校。

我曾试图向申请人解释，鉴于几乎每个欧洲国家都普遍存在大量失业现象，加之他除俄语外不懂其他语言，且缺乏资金，他在欧洲谋生将非常困难。

他声称已积蓄约3000美元，这是一笔相对较小的金额。如果找不到工作，这笔钱很快就会花光，之后他将陷入贫困。

我认为 Markizoff 先生正在向此处各领事馆逐一试探，并且

T.P. Givens 先生，
副总监（特别处），
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
